name: Levittown
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Levittown, PA 2026
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Levittown and Bristol, PA for 2026: tree lightings, a parade, Grinchmas, a Victorian holiday house and Sesame Place.
lede: Levittown families split the season between Bristol Township's park, the historic Bristol Borough riverfront and the Grinchmas fest at Bolton Mansion, with Sesame Place nearby in Langhorne.
celebrates: The Levittown area spreads its Christmas across two towns. Bristol Township holds its tree lighting at Municipal Park, and Bolton Mansion in Levittown hosts a Grinchmas food truck fest with Santa photos. A few minutes away, Bristol Borough lights its tree at Mill and Radcliffe streets, follows with a parade the next day, and opens the Grundy Mansion's Victorian Holiday House. Bristol Riverside Theatre stages A Christmas Story: The Play, and Sesame Place in Langhorne adds a Christmas show. Visit Bucks County and the host websites list the dates for each.
lastyear: Bristol Borough's 2025 Christmas tree stood at Mill and Radcliffe streets, and the borough's post on the tree lighting listed community caroling at 6:30 pm followed by a live appearance by Santa. The borough's earlier lightings are numbered, and a borough post counted its 43rd annual community Christmas tree lighting on Sunday, November 26, 2023. We did not find a published 2025 recap for the Bristol Township tree lighting.
facts: Bolton Mansion in Levittown is a National Register home on Holly Drive that Visit Bucks County says was built in three sections and later served as the headquarters of Levitt and Sons, the builder of Levittown. The Grundy Mansion at 610 Radcliffe Street in Bristol Borough is open as a museum, and Visit Bucks County says its Christmas trees are decorated by museum staff, volunteers and a local florist each year.
trains: Levittown does not have its own Christmas train. The closest holiday ride in Bucks County is Santa's North Pole Express at New Hope Railroad, which Visit Bucks County lists from November 20 to December 30, 2026, with Santa and Mrs. Claus aboard and a sleigh bell for every child. Check the New Hope page on this site for its dated listing.
train_links: The 1891 station and heritage railroad in New Hope, listed on our museum guide.
traditions: A Friday night lighting on Mill Street with activities at 6 pm, the program at 6:30 and the lighting at 7, per Visit Bucks County.
Levittown Now says the borough parade steps off at 1 pm on Farragut Avenue and ends near the tree on Mill Street.
A one-day food truck fest with Santa and the Grinch, moonbounces and pony rides, listed as free by Visit Bucks County.
The Grundy Mansion shows Christmas trees and displays from several countries on docent-led tours.
Bristol Riverside Theatre's stage version of the 1983 film, with kids tickets.
kidfact: At the Grundy Mansion, each room has Christmas from a different country, so kids can look for what changes from room to room.
faq: Bristol Township lights a tree at Municipal Park, Bolton Mansion hosts Grinchmas, and nearby Bristol Borough has its own tree lighting, parade, Victorian Holiday House and professional holiday play.
Is there a Christmas parade near Levittown?

Levittown Now reports that Bristol Borough holds its Christmas parade on Saturday, November 28, 2026, at 1 pm, along Farragut Avenue and Mill Street, with a quieter viewing area for children who need one.
Visit Bucks County lists Bolton Mansion on Holly Drive in Levittown, and its Grinchmas fest on December 5 is free.
Does Sesame Place have Christmas events?
Yes. Sesame Place in Langhorne has a live card on this page for A Very Furry Christmas, and the park's own site lists dates and tickets.
sources: Bristol Christmas Tree Lighting, Parade Slated For This Week
intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Levittown for 2026, and here is what he found: 8 family events, 4 of them free. The magic runs from November 27 (the Bristol Borough Tree Lighting and the Victorian Holiday House at the Grundy Museum) through January 3, 2027 (A Christmas Story at Bristol Riverside Theatre), with the Bristol Township Holiday Tree Lighting and Dickens Night in Langhorne (December 4), the Grinchmas Food Truck Fest (December 5) and the Bensalem Township Tree Lighting (December 6) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Levittown

  • 8 Christmas events for kids in Levittown
  • 4 free events: the Bristol Borough and Bristol Township tree lightings, Grinchmas at Bolton Mansion and the Bensalem Township Tree Lighting (bring a non-perishable food item)
  • Meet Santa: Bensalem Township Tree Lighting (December 6) and Dickens Night in Langhorne (December 4)
  • Parades, tree lightings and shows: A Christmas Story at Bristol Riverside Theatre (December 1 to January 3, 2027) and the Sesame Place holiday show
  • Season: November 27 to January 3, 2027

Planning a bigger day out? Levittown families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Philadelphia, which covers Christmas Village, the Macy's Wanamaker Light Show and Zoo Lights.
